execute_read_query.rationale: Pass-through (read): read-only, enforced upstream by the database role rather than by convention.

execute_write_query.rationale: Arbitrary INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and DDL. A single call can drop a table. This is the entire governed surface for this application.

get_insights.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): aggregated query performance statistics for a branch.

list_cluster_sizes.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): available cluster SKUs and pricing.

search_documentation.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): searches the public PlanetScale knowledge base with no account context.
